svg.title: Oxidation and reduction of D-glucose
svg.text: products prove: aldehyde group · 6-C chain · primary –OH
conc. HNO₃, warm : both –CHO and –CH₂OH oxidised
Gluconic acid ⇒ one –CHO (aldehyde). Saccharic acid ⇒ a terminal primary –CH₂OH is also present.
Glucitol on HI reduction gives 2-iodohexane / n-hexane ⇒ all six carbons lie in a straight chain.
